ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there is an outer rectangle, divided by thick lines into nine non-overlapping squares. Four larger corner squares are visible: upper left, lower left, upper right, lower right; in the middle region there is also an upper middle square, a center-left square, a center-right-upper square, a very small central square, and a center-right-lower square. Reasoning: Establish global coordinates according to the specified method. Let the upper-left corner of the outer rectangle be (0,0), the lower-right corner be (W,H), and the y-axis point downward. Let the visible vertical dividing lines from left to right be x1,x2,x3,x4, and the visible horizontal dividing lines from top to bottom be y1,y2,y3,y4. Since all small pieces are squares, obtain the equations: 1) Upper-left square: x1 = y3. 2) Upper-middle square: x4 - x1 = y1. 3) Upper-right square: W - x4 = y4. 4) Lower-left square: x3 = H - y3. 5) Lower-right square: W - x3 = H - y4. 6) Center-left square: x2 - x1 = y3 - y1. 7) Center-right-upper square: x4 - x2 = y2 - y1. 8) Very small central square: x3 - x2 = y3 - y2. 9) Center-right-lower square: x4 - x3 = y4 - y2. Solve this homogeneous linear system. From x1=y3, H=x3+x1, y1=x4-x1. From equation 6, get x2=3x1-x4. From equation 7, get y2=3x4-4x1. From equation 8, get x3=8x1-4x4. From equation 9, get y4=8x4-12x1. Also from W=x4+y4 and W=2x3+x1-y4, get x4+2y4=2x3+x1. After substituting x3,y4: x4+2(8x4-12x1)=2(8x1-4x4)+x1, so 17x4-24x1=17x1-8x4, that is, 25x4=41x1. Therefore x4=41x1/25. Continuing gives x3=36x1/25, y4=28x1/25. Thus W=x4+y4=69x1/25, H=x3+x1=61x1/25, so W:H=69:61. Because the problem states that the width and height are relatively prime positive integers, W=69, H=61. The rectangle perimeter is 2(W+H)=2(69+61)=260.

Let the visible vertical cut lines be x1, x2, x3, x4 from left to right, and the visible horizontal cut lines be y1, y2, y3, y4 from top to bottom, where x1 is the right edge of the upper-left square, x3 is the right edge of the lower-left square and left edge of the lower-right square, x4 is the left edge of the upper-right square, y3 is the bottom of the upper-left square/top of lower-left square, and y4 is the bottom of the upper-right square/top of lower-right square. Translate each square condition into equations: x1=y3, x4-x1=y1, W-x4=y4, x3=H-y3, W-x3=H-y4, x2-x1=y3-y1, x4-x2=y2-y1, x3-x2=y3-y2, and x4-x3=y4-y2. 图像描述：附图中有一个外部矩形，被粗线分割成九个互不重叠的正方形。可见四个较大的角部正方形：左上、左下、右上、右下；中间区域还有一个上方中间正方形、一个中央偏左正方形、一个中央偏右上正方形、一个很小的中央正方形、一个中央偏右下正方形。

推理：按指定方法建立全局坐标。设外矩形左上角为 (0,0)，右下角为 (W,H)，y 轴向下。设从左到右的可见竖直分割线为 x1,x2,x3,x4，从上到下的可见水平分割线为 y1,y2,y3,y4。

由各小块都是正方形得到方程：
1) 左上正方形：x1 = y3。
2) 上中正方形：x4 - x1 = y1。
3) 右上正方形：W - x4 = y4。
4) 左下正方形：x3 = H - y3。
5) 右下正方形：W - x3 = H - y4。
6) 中央偏左正方形：x2 - x1 = y3 - y1。
7) 中央偏右上正方形：x4 - x2 = y2 - y1。
8) 很小的中央正方形：x3 - x2 = y3 - y2。
9) 中央偏右下正方形：x4 - x3 = y4 - y2。

解这个齐次线性系统。由 x1=y3，H=x3+x1，y1=x4-x1。由第 6 式得 x2=3x1-x4。由第 7 式得 y2=3x4-4x1。由第 8 式得 x3=8x1-4x4。由第 9 式得 y4=8x4-12x1。又由 W=x4+y4 和 W=2x3+x1-y4，可得 x4+2y4=2x3+x1。代入 x3,y4 后：x4+2(8x4-12x1)=2(8x1-4x4)+x1，所以 17x4-24x1=17x1-8x4，即 25x4=41x1。

因此 x4=41x1/25。继续得到 x3=36x1/25，y4=28x1/25。于是 W=x4+y4=69x1/25，H=x3+x1=61x1/25，所以 W:H=69:61。

因为题目给出宽和高是互质正整数，所以 W=69，H=61。矩形周长为 2(W+H)=2(69+61)=260。

method.method_draft: Use local side-length propagation from the small central squares. From the image, label the tiny central square side t and the adjacent central lower-right square side s. The central upper-right square has side t+s because its side is split by the tiny and lower-right squares. The central-left square has side (t+s)+t=2t+s. The top-middle square has side (2t+s)+(t+s)=3t+2s. The upper-left square has side (3t+2s)+(2t+s)=5t+3s. The upper-right square has side (3t+2s)+(t+s)+s=4t+4s. The lower-left square reaches horizontally to the right edge of the tiny square, so its side is (5t+3s)+(2t+s)+t=8t+4s. Thus the total width from the top row is (5t+3s)+(3t+2s)+(4t+4s)=12t+9s, and the total height from the left side is (5t+3s)+(8t+4s)=13t+7s. The lower-right square side computed from width is (12t+9s)-(8t+4s)=4t+5s, while computed from height is (13t+7s)-(4t+4s)=9t+3s. Equate them: 4t+5s=9t+3s, so 2s=5t. The primitive integer choice is t=2, s=5, giving W=69 and H=61. Therefore the perimeter is 260.

raw_record.original_question: The diagram shows a rectangle that has been dissected into nine non-overlapping squares. Given that the width and the height of the rectangle are relatively prime positive integers, find the perimeter of the rectangle.
raw_record.final_cot:
Image description: In the attached figure there is an outer rectangle, divided by thick lines into nine non-overlapping squares. Four larger corner squares are visible: upper left, lower left, upper right, lower right; in the middle region there is also an upper middle square, a center-left square, a center-right-upper square, a very small central square, and a center-right-lower square.

Reasoning: Establish global coordinates according to the specified method. Let the upper-left corner of the outer rectangle be (0,0), the lower-right corner be (W,H), and the y-axis point downward. Let the visible vertical dividing lines from left to right be x1,x2,x3,x4, and the visible horizontal dividing lines from top to bottom be y1,y2,y3,y4.

Since all small pieces are squares, obtain the equations:
1) Upper-left square: x1 = y3.
2) Upper-middle square: x4 - x1 = y1.
3) Upper-right square: W - x4 = y4.
4) Lower-left square: x3 = H - y3.
5) Lower-right square: W - x3 = H - y4.
6) Center-left square: x2 - x1 = y3 - y1.
7) Center-right-upper square: x4 - x2 = y2 - y1.
8) Very small central square: x3 - x2 = y3 - y2.
9) Center-right-lower square: x4 - x3 = y4 - y2.

Solve this homogeneous linear system. From x1=y3, H=x3+x1, y1=x4-x1. From equation 6, get x2=3x1-x4. From equation 7, get y2=3x4-4x1. From equation 8, get x3=8x1-4x4. From equation 9, get y4=8x4-12x1. Also from W=x4+y4 and W=2x3+x1-y4, get x4+2y4=2x3+x1. After substituting x3,y4: x4+2(8x4-12x1)=2(8x1-4x4)+x1, so 17x4-24x1=17x1-8x4, that is, 25x4=41x1.

Therefore x4=41x1/25. Continuing gives x3=36x1/25, y4=28x1/25. Thus W=x4+y4=69x1/25, H=x3+x1=61x1/25, so W:H=69:61.

Because the problem states that the width and height are relatively prime positive integers, W=69, H=61. The rectangle perimeter is 2(W+H)=2(69+61)=260.
